Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.controlcenter

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.controlcenter
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps
     
  • Class
    Description
    AppearancePanel
    Appearance / wallpaper panel: enumerates the wallpapers bundled under the runtime resources/images/background tree (plus a custom image chosen from disk), previews them, and applies the selection by posting a BackgroundChangeRequestEvent with a SimpleImageBackground - the same mechanism the taskbar's theme icons use, so the live desktop background changes immediately.
    BluetoothPanel
    Bluetooth panel: adapter power, the controllers and known devices, and connect/disconnect for a selected device, over the BluetoothStatus (bluetoothctl / rfkill) seam.
    ControlCenter
    The control center application: the ControlCenterPanel (Display / Users / System / Appearance / Desktop) presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
    ControlCenterPanel
    The control center shell: a category navigation list on the left and a CardLayout on the right showing the selected ControlPanel.
    ControlPanel
    One category page of the control center.
    ControlPanelRegistry
    Discovers the control center's category panels.
    ControlPanelRegistry.PanelDescriptor
    A control-panel category known by name whose panel is constructed lazily, on first ControlPanelRegistry.PanelDescriptor.get(), and memoized thereafter.
    CustomizationPanel
    Personalisation ("Customization") category for the conventional 2D desktop: the independent look-and-feel sections that go beyond the wallpaper - the colour theme (Metal palette plus a single accent colour), the icon pack, the surface transparency and, in later phases, the window-decoration style.
    DateTimePanel
    Date & Time panel: shows the current time zone and local time, lets the user pick a zone from a JList (never a combo box, so the panel keeps working hosted offscreen in a SwingNode) and toggle NTP time synchronization.
    DesktopPanel
    Desktop configuration panel: taskbar thickness, docking position, icon size, the Swing application UI font, the taskbar auto-hide toggle, the taskbar's visible buttons and their label style, and the calendar's holiday region.
    DisplayPanel
    Display configuration panel backed by DisplayService (xrandr): lists connected outputs and lets the user pick a resolution, refresh rate, multi-monitor position, primary flag and scale.
    FileAssociationsPanel
    Default Applications panel: configures which application opens which kind of file (for example, the desktop's PDF Viewer opens .pdf).
    InputPanel
    Mouse & Keyboard panel: pointer acceleration/threshold and keyboard auto-repeat rate/delay, over the InputSettings (xset) seam.
    LocalePanel
    Language & Region panel: shows the current system LANG locale and lets the user pick another from a JList (never a combo box, so the panel keeps working hosted offscreen in a SwingNode).
    NetworkPanel
    Network panel (Phase 3 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.4).
    NotificationsPanel
    Notifications panel: the Do Not Disturb switch and the live notification log, over the Desktop2D control-center hooks.
    PowerPanel
    Power panel: battery charge, screen backlight brightness and the hardware temperature sensors, over the BatteryStatus, BrightnessStatus and ThermalService seams.
    PrintingPanel
    Printing panel: lists the CUPS printer queues, marks the system default, and offers the two management actions that do not need a full spooler UI - make a queue the default and submit a test page.
    QuickLaunchPanel
    Quick Launch panel: edits the pinned shortcut strip on the conventional Swing (2D) desktop's taskbar - the equivalent of the 3D taskbar's shortcut shelf - over the Desktop2D control-center hooks.
    SchedulePanel
    Schedule panel: two independent schedules that no longer share any control.
    ServicesPanel
    Service management panel (Phase 1 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.1).
    ShortcutsPanel
    Shortcuts panel: rebinds the 2D desktop's global keyboard shortcuts.
    SoundPanel
    Sound panel: a master output volume JSlider and mute toggle, plus a list of the host's output devices (sinks/cards) that can be inspected and switched, all over the VolumeStatus seam.
    StoragePanel
    Storage & LUKS panel (Phase 3 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.5).
    SystemInfoPanel
    System / About panel backed by SystemInfoService: CPU, memory, per-mount disk usage, kernel, distro, hostname, uptime, session and user, with live-updating CPU and memory gauges and a manual Refresh.
    SystemUpdatePanel
    Whole-system update panel (Phase 2 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.2).
    TaskSchedulerPanel
    Task Scheduler panel: the desktop's crontab.
    UsersPanel
    User administration panel backed by UserService: lists local accounts (optionally including system accounts), shows their details and group membership, and performs add / edit / set-password / groups / remove through pkexec.
    WorkspacesPanel
    Workspaces panel: how many virtual desktops the 2D shell offers, which one is shown, and how many windows sit on each, over the Desktop2D control-center hooks.
